title: cheapen — afterward

sentences.sentence: ...thorny hawthorn trees.
sentences.translation: …带刺的山楂树。

sentences.sentence: The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
sentences.translation: 可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。

sentences.sentence: If you have ever experienced the childlike delight of discovering an inchworm, you know how fun they are to watch.
sentences.translation: 如果你有过看到尺蠖露出孩子般灿烂笑脸的经历，你就知道观察尺蠖是多么有趣。

sentences.sentence: And with the inchworm, he flew to where other birds needed to be measured.
sentences.translation: 知更鸟带著尺蠖飞到其他鸟需要被测量的地方。

sentences.sentence: Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
sentences.translation: 乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

phrases.translation: 电压互感器；电压变量器
稳压；电压调整；电压变动率
工作电压；工诅压；操作电压

sentences.sentence: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
sentences.translation: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

sentences.sentence: The heroic leader charged into battle, ready to smite the enemy.
sentences.translation: 英勇的军官冲上战场，准备重击敌人。

phrases.translation: 凸轮从动件；凸轮从动滚轮；挺杆；凸轮跟随器
从动件运动规律；从动件停歇

sentences.sentence: Marx and his followers were convinced that capitalism would destroy itself.
sentences.translation: 马克思及其支持者确信资本主义将自我毁灭。

sentences.sentence: Whether you stay or leave is a matter of total indifference to me (= I do not care ).
sentences.translation: 你是留是走我根本无所谓。

sentences.sentence: His eyelids began to droop (= close, because he was sleepy ).
sentences.translation: 他的眼皮开始往下垂。

sentences.sentence: The room spun. Her eyelids fluttered (= moved up and down quickly ) and she fainted.
sentences.translation: 房间快速旋转起来。她的眼皮上下翻动，然后便昏了过去。

sentences.sentence: The hotel is modern and comfortably furnished .
sentences.translation: 这家宾馆很现代化，家具很舒适。

sentences.sentence: his comfortably baggy jeans
sentences.translation: 他那宽松舒适的牛仔裤

sentences.sentence: Would I feel better if I took a hatchet to her, just to end this nightmare?
sentences.translation: 如果我向她举起一把短柄斧，结束这场噩梦，我会感觉好一些吗？

phrases.translation: 另有所图；有不同意见；别有用心

sentences.sentence: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
sentences.translation: 每年1万个慢性肺病患者的死亡可能是由于吸烟导致的。

sentences.sentence: ...the predominance of women in the industry.
sentences.translation: ...该产业妇女在数量上拥有的优势。

phrases.translation: 反极性；极性变换；极性倒转

sentences.sentence: Whether you want to call it magnetism, polarity,electricity, thought, intelligence or charisma, it's still attraction, and it invests everything—animal, vegetable or mineral.
sentences.translation: 不论你管它叫磁性、极性、活力、体贴、智慧还是魅力，它们都是吸引力，而且它适用于一切------动物、蔬菜或矿物。

sentences.sentence: Several people have asked me about the origins of the polarity concept I began exploring last year.
sentences.translation: 有几个人曾问我有关极性概念的由来，极性概念是我去年开始研究的。

sentences.sentence: When they gradually increased the repulsive forces between the atoms, they observed several features indicating that the gas had become ferromagnetic.
sentences.translation: 他们利用红外线激光束捕获超冷锂原子气团，将其冷却到仅比绝对零度高亿分之十五开尔文。 当逐渐增加原子间斥力时，研究人员观察到的几个现象表明气体已经变得具有强磁性。

sentences.sentence: It is suggested that wearers of cardiac pacemakers, ferromagnetic implants and implanted electronic devices should avoid locations where the field exceeds 0.5 mT.
sentences.translation: 建议植有心脏起搏器、铁磁植入器和植入电子器件的人回避超过0.5 mT的静电磁场。

sentences.sentence: We're still just beginning to exploit atomic-scale effects in revolutionary new materials —semiconductors (processing power), ferromagnetic compounds (storage), and fiber optics (bandwidth).
sentences.translation: 我们对量子效应的初步开发，正始于那些革命性的新材料——半导体(处理器)、铁磁混合物（存储器）以及光纤材料（带宽）。

sentences.sentence: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
sentences.translation: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 442 单元

cheapen
音标：英 /'tʃiːp(ə)n/  美 /'tʃipən/
v. 减价, 跌价

thorny
音标：英 /'θɔːnɪ/  美 /'θɔrni/
adj. 多刺的, 痛苦的
例句：...thorny hawthorn trees.
…带刺的山楂树。

inchworm
音标：英 /'ɪn(t)ʃwɜːm/  美 /'ɪntʃwɝm/
n. [昆] 尺蠖
例句：The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。
例句：If you have ever experienced the childlike delight of discovering an inchworm, you know how fun they are to watch.
如果你有过看到尺蠖露出孩子般灿烂笑脸的经历，你就知道观察尺蠖是多么有趣。
例句：And with the inchworm, he flew to where other birds needed to be measured.
知更鸟带著尺蠖飞到其他鸟需要被测量的地方。

escalator
音标：英 /'eskəleɪtə/  美 /'ɛskə'letɚ/
n. 电动扶梯
例句：Take the escalator to the third floor and it's the last office on the left.
乘电梯到4楼，左边最后的那个办公室就是。

voltage
音标：英 /'vəʊltɪdʒ; 'vɒltɪdʒ/  美 /'voltɪdʒ/
n. [电工]电压, 伏特数
短语：low voltage — 低电压
短语：output voltage — 输出电压
短语：voltage stability — 电压稳定；电压稳定度
短语：input voltage — 输入电压；工作电压
短语：dc voltage — 直流电压；直羚压
短语：rated voltage — [化]额定电压
短语：voltage control — 电压控制
短语：voltage regulator — 稳压器；调压器
短语：voltage source — n. 电压电源
短语：supply voltage — 电源电压；供给电压
短语：voltage drop — 电压降落
短语：ac voltage — 交流电压；交羚压
短语：voltage transformer — 电压互感器；电压变量器
短语：constant voltage — 恒定电压；定压
短语：voltage regulation — 稳压；电压调整；电压变动率
短语：arc voltage — 弧电压
短语：working voltage — 工作电压；工诅压；操作电压
短语：breakdown voltage — [电]击穿电压
短语：medium voltage — 中压
短语：applied voltage — 外加电压
例句：The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

smite
音标：英 /smaɪt/  美 /smaɪt/
v. 重击
例句：The heroic leader charged into battle, ready to smite the enemy.
英勇的军官冲上战场，准备重击敌人。

follower
音标：英 /'fɒləʊə/  美 /'fɑloɚ/
n. 追随者, 信徒
短语：roller follower — 滚子从动件；滚轮挺杆
短语：cam follower — 凸轮从动件；凸轮从动滚轮；挺杆；凸轮跟随器
短语：follower motion — 从动件运动规律；从动件停歇
例句：Marx and his followers were convinced that capitalism would destroy itself.
马克思及其支持者确信资本主义将自我毁灭。

indifference
音标：英 /ɪn'dɪf(ə)r(ə)ns/  美 /ɪn'dɪfrəns/
n. 不关心
短语：indifference curve — [经]无差异曲线
例句：Whether you stay or leave is a matter of total indifference to me (= I do not care ).
你是留是走我根本无所谓。

eyelid
音标：英 /'aɪlɪd/  美 /'aɪ,lɪd/
n. 眼皮, 眼睑
例句：His eyelids began to droop (= close, because he was sleepy ).
他的眼皮开始往下垂。
例句：The room spun. Her eyelids fluttered (= moved up and down quickly ) and she fainted.
房间快速旋转起来。她的眼皮上下翻动，然后便昏了过去。

comfortably
音标：英 /'kʌmfətəbli/  美 /'kʌmftəbli/
adv. 舒适地
短语：comfortably off — adj. 相当富有的
例句：The hotel is modern and comfortably furnished .
这家宾馆很现代化，家具很舒适。
例句：his comfortably baggy jeans
他那宽松舒适的牛仔裤

hatchet
音标：英 /'hætʃɪt/  美 /'hætʃɪt/
n. 短柄斧
短语：bury the hatchet — v. 和解；停战
短语：hatchet job — n. 恶毒攻击；诽谤
例句：Would I feel better if I took a hatchet to her, just to end this nightmare?
如果我向她举起一把短柄斧，结束这场噩梦，我会感觉好一些吗？

axe
音标：英 /æks/  美 /æks/
n. 斧, (经费的)大削减
短语：get the axe — 被开除
短语：an axe to grind — 另有所图；有不同意见；别有用心
短语：ice axe — 冰镐

ambidextrous
音标：英 /,æmbɪ'dekstrəs/  美 /'æmbə'dɛkstrəs/
adj. 十分灵巧的

attributable
音标：英 /ə'trɪbjʊtəbl/  美 /ə'trɪbjətəbl/
adj. 可归因于的
例句：10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
每年1万个慢性肺病患者的死亡可能是由于吸烟导致的。

predominance
音标：英 /prɪ'dɒmɪnəns/  美 /prɪ'dɑmɪnəns/
n. 优势
例句：...the predominance of women in the industry.
...该产业妇女在数量上拥有的优势。

petrify
音标：英 /'petrɪfaɪ/  美 /'pɛtrɪfaɪ/
v. 石化,吓呆

polarity
音标：英 /pə(ʊ)'lærɪtɪ/  美 /pə'lærəti/
n. 极性
短语：reverse polarity — [电子]反极性；逆偏振
短语：opposite polarity — 相反极性
短语：polarity reversal — 反极性；极性变换；极性倒转
短语：negative polarity — 负极性
短语：polarity effect — 极性效应；极化效应
短语：reversed polarity — 反极性
例句：Whether you want to call it magnetism, polarity,electricity, thought, intelligence or charisma, it's still attraction, and it invests everything—animal, vegetable or mineral.
不论你管它叫磁性、极性、活力、体贴、智慧还是魅力，它们都是吸引力，而且它适用于一切------动物、蔬菜或矿物。
例句：Several people have asked me about the origins of the polarity concept I began exploring last year.
有几个人曾问我有关极性概念的由来，极性概念是我去年开始研究的。

ax
音标：英 /æks/  美 /æks/
n. 斧头 vt削减

ferromagnetic
音标：英 /,ferə(ʊ)mæg'netɪk/  美 /,fɛromæɡ'nɛtɪk/
adj. 铁磁的
短语：ferromagnetic material — 铁磁材料；强磁性质
短语：ferromagnetic resonance — 铁磁共振
例句：When they gradually increased the repulsive forces between the atoms, they observed several features indicating that the gas had become ferromagnetic.
他们利用红外线激光束捕获超冷锂原子气团，将其冷却到仅比绝对零度高亿分之十五开尔文。 当逐渐增加原子间斥力时，研究人员观察到的几个现象表明气体已经变得具有强磁性。
例句：It is suggested that wearers of cardiac pacemakers, ferromagnetic implants and implanted electronic devices should avoid locations where the field exceeds 0.5 mT.
建议植有心脏起搏器、铁磁植入器和植入电子器件的人回避超过0.5 mT的静电磁场。
例句：We're still just beginning to exploit atomic-scale effects in revolutionary new materials —semiconductors (processing power), ferromagnetic compounds (storage), and fiber optics (bandwidth).
我们对量子效应的初步开发，正始于那些革命性的新材料——半导体(处理器)、铁磁混合物（存储器）以及光纤材料（带宽）。

afterward
音标：英 /'ɑːftəwəd/  美 /ˈæftərwərd/
adv. 然后, 后来
例句：Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。
